Тысячу лет мир Хоргат горел в бесконечно: For a thousand years the world of Horgat burned in endless war. Brand outlived forty-seven emperors, buried his own sons and led his legion to the final victory. But the victors were left with nothing save dead earth. When the first gate opened, Brand beheld the blooming valleys of Valenholm. He did not come for glory. At his back stood thousands of surviving warriors to whom he had sworn a new homeland. And the marshal had no intention of breaking his last oath.
В своём мире Морр считался величайшим це: In his own world, Morr was hailed as the greatest of healers. Millions worshipped him, never suspecting that every dreadful disease had been crafted by his own hands. He sold salvation to those he himself had doomed to die. When the last inhabitant of Mor perished, the great physician was left without patients. The second gate gave him millions of new victims. And Morr has already prepared his greatest remedy for them.
Когда-то бесконечные леса Эсса принадлеж: Once the boundless forests of Ess belonged to an ancient serpent people. But conquerors from another world burned their kingdom together with its young. Sissara saved only the last three eggs of her kind. Ardan promised her a new home beyond the third gate. Now the queen means to turn the forests of Valenholm into a sanctuary for her children. But in that sanctuary not a single human may remain.
Глотт родился самым слабым и уродливым с: Glott was born the weakest and ugliest creature of his world. All his life he dreamed of seeing the great bend the knee before him. Having mastered ancient magic, he drowned entire kingdoms and turned their people into obedient toads. Now the fourth gate has opened amid the swamps of Valenholm. Glott desires one thing: to sink the whole world beneath the water, so that no living creature may ever rise above him again.
Тысячу лет назад гномы Дургара отправили: A thousand years ago the dwarves of Durgar descended into the depths of the earth, commanding their great iron guardian to watch over their home. They never returned. For a thousand years Targrim lit the empty smithies and waited for the footsteps of his makers. When the fifth gate opened in the mines of Valenholm, he heard the familiar ring of hammers. The guardian decided that his masters had come back. And now no one will dare take from him the home he has found.
Двести лет Ильва наблюдала, как войны ун: For two hundred years Ilva watched wars destroy her beautiful Hjolm. Unable to stop the suffering, the queen stopped time itself. She sealed millions of her subjects in eternal ice. There no one ages, no one starves and no one dies. Even her own son Ilva lulled to sleep in a cradle of ice. Through the sixth gate she has come to grant the people of Valenholm the same salvation. And neither the tears of mothers nor the pleas of children will make her forsake her mercy.
Аврелий был прекраснейшим правителем сво: Aurelius was the most beautiful ruler of his world. But his first wrinkle taught him fear. He discovered a magic that turns the souls of others into years of his own youth. First the criminals vanished. Then the commoners. Then his family. In the end, nothing remained of an entire people but reflections. Now the seventh gate leads to the Mirror City of Valenholm, where the immortal lord prepares a place for millions of new souls.
Ксарр существовал ещё до рождения первых: Xarr existed before the first kingdoms were born. He craved no riches, sought no power and knew no fear. His only joy was to watch all that is beautiful perish. The gods of his world bound the monster in chains beneath a dead volcano. But Ardan shattered the fetters. Through the eighth gate Xarr felt the breath of a new world. A world where gardens still bloom, children are born and people dream of tomorrow. To him, it is the greatest of gifts.
За девятыми вратами простирается царство: Beyond the ninth gate lies the realm of the gods themselves. But the golden thrones stand empty. The sacred fires have gone out. Only Seraphin remains — the immortal judge by whose hands the will of the heavens was carried out for millennia. He never doubted the orders of his masters. Now Seraphin guards the last secret of the gods. A secret for which an innocent child was sacrificed. And no one is permitted to learn the truth.

За последними вратами нет ни городов, ни: Beyond the last gate there are neither cities nor armies. Only a silent abyss and a throne upon which sits the greatest mage who ever lived. Once Ardan was mankind's most devoted defender. His wisdom saved kingdoms, and his loyalty to the gods knew no bounds. But one day the only thing dearer to him than eternity was taken from him. For a thousand years he searched for an answer. And when he found it, he opened the ten gates. Now the whole world must learn why the most faithful servant of the heavens became their greatest enemy.
Лучший стрелок дворцовой стражи. Замок п: The finest shot of the palace guard. The castle fell, yet she never came down from the wall — and she fires on anyone who approaches the gate.
Сорок лет исполнял приговоры короля. Нов: For forty years he carried out the king's sentences. The castle's new master kept him at his trade: the stocks and the chopping block are in use once more.
Несёт знамя павшего короля, но служит те: He bears the banner of the fallen king, but now he serves the Black Knight. As long as the standard is raised, his knights do not retreat.
Ученик доктора Морра. Ходит по горящим д: A pupil of Doctor Morr. He walks the burning yards with a bag full of flasks — and not one of them heals.
Соломенное пугало, ожившее от чумного ды: A straw scarecrow brought to life by plague smoke. It reaps not wheat, but those who still remain in the village.
Деревенский бык, обезумевший в пожаре. О: A village bull driven mad by the blaze. The fire has eaten into his hide, and now he carries the flames wherever he runs.
Паучиха, что плетёт сети между старыми д: A spider who weaves her webs between the old oaks. In her cocoons sleep those who strayed from the path.
Дух леса, отравленный змеиной магией Сис: A spirit of the forest, poisoned by Sissara's serpent magic. The roots obey her, and the flowers around her are venomous.
Охотится только ночью — но в лесу Сиссар: She hunts only at night — but in Sissara's forest the night never ends. Her spear glows with moonlight.
Её свадьба так и не состоялась: Глотт ут: Her wedding never came to pass: Glott drowned the village, and her groom with it. Her weeping drags the living to the bottom.
Старейший хищник трясины. Лежит неподвиж: The oldest predator of the quagmire. It lies still as a log — until the first step into the water.
Три головы — три струи яда. Глотт держит: Three heads — three streams of venom. Glott keeps it by the deepest pools.
Один из немногих гномов, кто не ушёл в г: One of the few dwarves who did not go into the depths. His armor hisses with steam, and his hook reaches even around the corner of a mine tunnel.
Таргрим принял его за вернувшегося масте: Targrim took him for a returning master and set him to digging ore. He hurls pickaxes as deftly as he swings them.
Его панцирь вырос из самоцветов шахты. Н: Its shell grew from the gems of the mine. It strikes from below the ground — right where the floor was a moment ago.
Маленькая служанка Ильвы. Её искры краси: Ilva's little handmaid. Her sparks are beautiful, but each one leaves frost on the skin, and after the frost — ice.
Огромный зверь северных льдов. В ярости: A huge beast of the northern ice. In its fury it sweeps away everything in its path with a wall of snow.
Сторожит перевал к ледяному дворцу. Её д: It guards the pass to the ice palace. Its breath is a hail of ice shards.
Последняя из храмовой стражи Аврелия. Зн: The last of Aurelius's temple guard. She knows every slab in the ruins — and has hidden a trap beneath each one.
Живое отражение, сбежавшее из зеркала. П: A living reflection that escaped from a mirror. It takes on the guise of its foe and flows like quicksilver.
Тот, кто считал годы для бессмертного вл: The one who counted the years for the immortal lord. He can stop a moment — though not for long.
Черепаха, что тысячу лет спала в лаве. П: A turtle that slept in lava for a thousand years. Its shell cannot be pierced, and its maw spits fire.
Служитель Ксарра. Носит на себе цепи, ко: A servant of Xarr. He wears the very chains that once bound his master.
Птица, рождённая из пепла сгоревших садо: A bird born from the ashes of burned gardens. Killing it is not enough — it rises again.
Стражница облачных садов. Её стрелы несё: A guardian of the cloud gardens. Her arrows are carried by the wind itself.
Ковала оружие для небесного воинства. Её: She forged weapons for the heavenly host. Her hammer strikes like the dawn — blindingly.
Охраняет врата Небесного храма. Тот, кто: It guards the gate of the Sky Temple. Whoever does not know the answer to its riddle hears its roar.
Тварь из Бездны, что кормится снами. Нас: A creature of the Abyss that feeds on dreams. It sends nightmares and drains the strength of the sleeping.
Ожившая скала с дороги к трону Ардана. В: A rock come to life from the road to Ardan's throne. Within it lies a sphere of void that pulls in everything around it.
Сторож последних врат. Его огонь горит б: The watchman of the last gate. His fire burns without heat, and his pits lead straight into the Abyss.
